hooks.command: input=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/*.rs) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; r=${f#"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/}; m="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/tengu-tutorial-sync-$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.session_id // "none"')"; touch "$m"; awk -v r="$r" '$0 == r { s = 1 } END { exit !s }' "$m" && exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$r" >> "$m"; pages=$(awk -v f="$r" '/^[ \t]*#/ { next } /^\[/ { p = ""; g = ($0 == "[glue]") } /^\[pages\./ { p = substr($0, 8, length($0) - 8) } match($0, /"[^"]+"/) { s = substr($0, RSTART + 1, RLENGTH - 2); if (s == f || (s ~ /\/$/ && index(f, s) == 1)) { if (g) glue = 1; else if (p != "" && !(p in seen)) { seen[p] = 1; out = out (out == "" ? "" : ", ") "docs/tutorial/" p ".html" } } } END { if (out == "" && glue) out = "-"; print out }' "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docs/tutorial/sources.toml"); case "$pages" in -) exit 0 ;; "") msg="Tutorial sync: $r is in no page of docs/tutorial/sources.toml. Map it to a page or [glue], then run cargo test --test tutorial_map." ;; *) msg="Tutorial sync: $r is explained by $pages. Before you finish, update them, bump their footer date and run cargo test --test tutorial_map (docs/tutorial/AUTHORING.md). Shown once per file per session." ;; esac; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:$m}}'
